summary: Same patient on day 3 of IV hydrocortisone: 10 stools/day, CRP 52 — Travis criteria predict colectomy. Rescue therapy (infliximab or ciclosporin) or colectomy after joint gastroenterology–colorectal review; CMV on biopsies.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Ongoing bloody diarrhoea on IV steroids
inputs.hpi: Day 3 of IV hydrocortisone 100 mg four times daily for acute severe ulcerative colitis. Still 10 bloody stools in the last 24 h. Stool culture negative, C. difficile toxin negative. Flexible sigmoidoscopy: severe continuous colitis to 30 cm; biopsies pending (CMV immunohistochemistry requested). On enoxaparin prophylaxis.

exam.abdomen: Mildly distended, tender over the left colon, no guarding or peritonism. Bowel sounds present.

imaging.name: AXR
imaging.result: No colonic dilatation (transverse colon 4.8 cm). Oedematous left colon. No free gas.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Acute severe ulcerative colitis — steroid-refractory at day 3
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Acute severe UC, day 3 of IV steroids: 10 stools/day, CRP 52 — Oxford (Travis) criteria met, high colectomy risk. Rescue therapy (infliximab or ciclosporin) versus colectomy; joint medical-surgical review.

mustInclude.proposedFix: Add "flexible sigmoidoscopy with biopsies incl. CMV (IHC/PCR)" to the ASUC/steroid-refractory steps (ECCO 2021).

guideline.name: Oxford (Travis) criteria — predicting outcome in severe ulcerative colitis
guideline.section: Day-3 predictors of colectomy: > 8 stools, or 3–8 stools with CRP > 45
guideline.citation: Travis SP, Farrant JM, Ricketts C, et al. Predicting outcome in severe ulcerative colitis. Gut. 1996;38:905–910.

guideline.name: ECCO guidelines on therapeutics in ulcerative colitis — medical treatment
guideline.section: Rescue therapy with infliximab or ciclosporin for steroid-refractory ASUC
guideline.citation: Raine T, Bonovas S, Burisch J, et al. ECCO guidelines on therapeutics in ulcerative colitis: medical treatment. J Crohns Colitis. 2022;16:2–17.

guideline.name: ECCO guidelines on therapeutics in ulcerative colitis — surgical treatment
guideline.section: Subtotal colectomy with end ileostomy when medical therapy fails; do not delay surgery
guideline.citation: Spinelli A, Bonovas S, Burisch J, et al. ECCO guidelines on therapeutics in ulcerative colitis: surgical treatment. J Crohns Colitis. 2022;16:179–189.

guideline.name: BSG consensus guidelines — management of inflammatory bowel disease in adults
guideline.citation: Lamb CA, Kennedy NA, Raine T, et al. British Society of Gastroenterology consensus guidelines on the management of inflammatory bowel disease in adults. Gut. 2019;68(Suppl 3):s1–s106.

guideline.name: ECCO guidelines — prevention, diagnosis and management of infections in IBD
guideline.citation: Kucharzik T, Ellul P, Greuter T, et al. ECCO guidelines on the prevention, diagnosis, and management of infections in inflammatory bowel disease. J Crohns Colitis. 2021;15:879–913.

rationale: Permutation: time on steroids. Checks the plan escalates at day 3 (rescue therapy or colectomy) instead of repeating the admission bundle.

authoring.author: Claude (colorectal/anorectal cluster)
